Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent

Class ModelKeys

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.ModelKeys
All Implemented Interfaces:
ForeignKeySource
public final class ModelKeys extends Object implements ForeignKeySource
Reads the key of a model so a migration can add a foreign column for it with blueprint.foreignIdFor(ModelKeys.of(User.class)).

The values come from the model's own configuration: the foreign key name, the table without the connection's prefix, the primary key column and the kind of key. An integer key gives ForeignKeySource.KeyKind.INTEGER; a unique id model gives ULID for a ULID key and UUID for a UUID key. Any other key type is refused.
